previous_statement: For the package from lem-routef-upsilon-prime-component-construction define K_j(S):=Lambda_j^*(S tensor I_F)Lambda_j and K(S):=(K_j(S))_j. Each Lambda_j is a contraction, so every compression K_j is CP with cb norm at most 1; the finite direct-sum norm is the maximum of component norms, hence ||K||_cb <= 1, and the defining formula for Upsilon'_j gives Upsilon'=K Phi.
new_statement: For the package from lem-routef-upsilon-prime-component-construction define K_j(T):=Lambda_j^*(T tensor I_F)Lambda_j for T in B(H), and K(T):=(K_j(T))_j. Each Lambda_j is a contraction, so every compression K_j is CP with cb norm at most 1; the finite direct-sum norm is the maximum of component norms, hence ||K||_cb <= 1, and the defining formula for Upsilon'_j gives Upsilon'=K Phi.
